why: Printer profiles Nozzle It All doesn't offer yet. Since nozzle-engine e23c0df (docs/upstream/PROVENANCE.md P-0023, P-0024) the engine slices all six (upstream OrcaSlicer's multi-extruder / multi-nozzle system is ported), but none has been printed on a real machine. On the two-extruder models filaments go to extruders by upstream's default rule (filament i on extruder i, the rest on the master extruder); the app has no per-filament choice yet. Owner decision 2026-09-27: hidden until tested on a real machine.
